title: On Admiring the old bridge at dawn
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：admire　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 admire 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the keeper ① admired the old bridge at dawn in the rain, and every child in the zoo said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② admires the old bridge at dawn without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ admire the old bridge at dawn at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ admired the old bridge at dawn before — a line in the register for March 1984 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Admiring the old bridge at dawn in the rain, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ admire the quiet way she worked without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Admire the quiet way she worked at once and never mention it again.

By 1997 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the register, and a new child from the next zoo ⑧ admires the quiet way she worked in the rain every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shed, said nothing at all; she simply  admired the old bridge at dawn again when nobody else would.

To admire the old bridge at dawn, my mother said in 2002, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the zoo remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the zoo forgets, somebody admires the old bridge at dawn without complaint again and somebody must admire the old bridge at dawn in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 欣赏（一般过去式 admired the old bridge at dawn：1990 年饲养员头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 欣赏（一般现在 admires the old bridge at dawn：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 欣赏（不定式 to admire the old bridge at dawn：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 欣赏（过去完成时 had admired the old bridge at dawn：1984 年三月的饲养台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 欣赏（动名词 admiring the old bridge at dawn 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 佩服（admire the quiet way she worked：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去佩服她做事的那份安静）
G. v. 佩服（admire the quiet way she worked：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 欣赏（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 admires the quiet way she worked，而母亲又一次 admired the old bridge at dawn）

items.q: admired the old bridge at dawn
admires the old bridge at dawn
to admire the old bridge at dawn
admired the old bridge at dawn before
admiring the old bridge at dawn
admire the quiet way she worked without complaint
admire the quiet way she worked at once
admires the quiet way she worked in the rain

answers.why: admire 意为“欣赏”，1990 年饲养员淋着雨欣赏天亮时分的那座旧桥，那是兽舍里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 admired。
admire 意为“欣赏”，自那以后饲养员毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 admires。
admire 意为“欣赏”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯欣赏天亮时分的那座旧桥”，此处为不定式 to admire the old bridge at dawn。
admire 意为“欣赏”，饲养台账里 三月 那行字说明早在 1997 年之前就有人欣赏过，故用过去完成时 had admired。
admire 意为“欣赏”，饲养员说“欣赏天亮时分的那座旧桥这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 admiring the old bridge at dawn 作主语。
admire 意为“佩服”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去佩服她做事的那份安静”，should ever 之后用原形 admire the quiet way she worked。
admire 意为“佩服”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻佩服她做事的那份安静（admire the quiet way she worked at once），以后再也不要提起。
admire 意为“欣赏”，新来的孩子每个季度都照例佩服她做事的那份安静，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 admires。

饲养员说过，淋着雨欣赏天亮时分的那座旧桥这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（admiring the old bridge at dawn 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻佩服她做事的那份安静，以后再也不要提起。（admire the quiet way she worked，祈使句）

Somebody had admired the old bridge at dawn long before 1997, and the line in the register for March proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 admire 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1990 the keeper admired the old bridge at dawn in the rain, and nobody in the zoo forgot it.
Even now the keeper admires the old bridge at dawn without complaint whenever the zoo asks.
Admiring the old bridge at dawn in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever admire the quiet way she worked without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next zoo admires the quiet way she worked in the rain every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother admired the old bridge at dawn again, and the zoo remembered that half.
